mainTopic: Which rule is the הלכה למשה מסיני (the barley-grain bone), the end of פרק כהן גדול, and the new משנה about two נזירים with a doubtful טומאה, along with the גמרא's challenge from סוטה.
overview: The גמרא goes back to the end of the previous משנה, where רבי עקיבא's קל וחומר was rejected because one may not build a קל וחומר from a הלכה למשה מסיני. It asks which rule was the הלכה, the barley-grain bone or the רביעית of blood. A ברייתא answers clearly: the bone is the הלכה, and the רביעית of blood was the failed קל וחומר. The פרק then closes with a הדרן. A new משנה follows about two נזירים told that one of them became impure, without knowing which. Together they bring one impurity offering and one purity offering. Then both count thirty days and bring one more purity offering, with conditions saying whose offering is whose. The גמרא challenges this: the rule that a doubt in a רשות היחיד is impure comes from סוטה, which involves just two people. Here the witness makes three, so the doubt should be pure. רבה בר רב הונא answers that the witness saw something impure thrown between them from a distance. רב אשי begins to show that the משנה's wording supports this, and the proof continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Which rule is the הלכה from Sinai?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks which case in the משנה was the הלכה למשה מסיני and which was the קל וחומר that failed: the barley-grain bone or the רביעית of blood.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: A question was asked. Is the barley-grain bone the הלכה, while the quarter-log of blood was the קל וחומר, and we don't build a קל וחומר from a הלכה? Or maybe the quarter-log of blood is the הלכה, while the barley-grain bone was the קל וחומר, and we don't build a קל וחומר from a הלכה?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens with a question with two sides. It wants to know which of the two rules in the משנה was the הלכה למשה מסיני.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the משנה, רבי עקיבא tried to link the barley-grain bone and the רביעית of blood with a קל וחומר. He was told that a קל וחומר cannot be built from a הלכה. The משנה did not say clearly which of the two rules was the הלכה, so the גמרא lays out both possibilities.

keyTerms.meaning: A question was raised before them (the Sages)
A bone the size of a barley grain
A quarter-log of blood
Here, a הלכה למשה מסיני: a rule handed down orally from Sinai
A logical argument from a lighter case to a stricter case
We do not build a קל וחומר on top of a הלכה למשה מסיני

steps.confusionAlert: The two sides use exactly the same words, just switched around. Watch which case is called הלכה and which is called קל וחומר in each half.

phrases.english: Gemara:
A question was asked before them:
Is a bone the size of a barley grain the halacha,
phrases.notes: "הלכה" here means a rule handed down from Sinai, the one mentioned at the end of the משנה.

phrases.english: and a quarter-log of blood the kal vachomer,
and we do not derive a kal vachomer from a halacha?
Or perhaps:
a quarter-log of blood is the halacha,
and a bone the size of a barley grain is the kal vachomer,
and we do not derive a kal vachomer from a halacha?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא on the end of the previous משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which of the two rules, the barley-grain bone or the רביעית of blood, is the הלכה למשה מסיני, and which is the קל וחומר that was rejected?

steps.title: A ברייתא settles it: the bone is the הלכה
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא states clearly that the barley-grain bone is the הלכה and the רביעית of blood is the קל וחומר, so the קל וחומר is rejected.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: A barley-grain bone is the הלכה, a quarter-log of blood is the קל וחומר, and we don't build a קל וחומר from a הלכה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers its question by quoting a ברייתא that says outright which rule is which.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא confirms the first side of the question. The barley-grain bone rule comes from Sinai. The attempt to extend it to a רביעית of blood was the קל וחומר, and that attempt fails because a הלכה למשה מסיני cannot serve as the base of a קל וחומר.
steps.whatToRemember: The barley-grain bone is the הלכה למשה מסיני. The רביעית of blood was only a proposed קל וחומר, and it is rejected because we do not build a קל וחומר from a הלכה.

phrases.english: Come and hear:
A bone the size of a barley grain is the halacha,
and a quarter-log of blood is the kal vachomer,
and we do not derive a kal vachomer from a halacha.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 1 with a ברייתא.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The barley-grain bone is the הלכה; the רביעית of blood was the rejected קל וחומר.

steps.title: הדרן — Closing פרק כהן גדול
steps.stepSummary: The closing formula marking the end of the seventh פרק of נזיר, פרק כהן גדול.
steps.simpleTranslation: We will return to you, פרק כהן גדול.
steps.whatsHappening: This line simply marks the end of the פרק. It is not part of the discussion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The הדרן is a traditional farewell said when finishing a פרק, expressing the hope to come back and learn it again. The topic changes completely after this line.

keyTerms.meaning: We will return to you: the formula said on finishing a פרק
High Priest: the name of the פרק that just ended

phrases.english: We will return to you,
Kohen Gadol.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes the פרק after the final answer in step 2.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The seventh פרק of נזיר is complete.

steps.title: Two נזירים, one of whom became impure
steps.stepSummary: The new פרק opens with two נזירים who were told that one of them became impure, but not which one. Both shave and together bring one impurity offering and one purity offering, each stating a condition about whose offering is whose.
steps.simpleTranslation: Two נזירים were told by someone: "I saw one of you become impure, but I don't know which one." They shave and bring an impurity offering and a purity offering. One says to the other: "If I am the impure one, the impurity offering is mine and the purity offering is yours. If I am the pure one, the purity offering is mine and the impurity offering is yours."
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins a new פרק. It describes how two נזירים handle a doubt about which of them became טמא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Exactly one of the two is טמא and the other is טהור, but nobody knows which. So together they bring one קרבן טומאה and one קרבן טהרה. Each one states a condition, so that each offering automatically belongs to whichever person it really fits.

keyTerms.meaning: People who took a נזירות vow
Became ritually impure, here through a dead body
They shave their hair, as a נזיר does at the end of the vow or after becoming impure
The offering a נזיר brings after becoming impure
The offering a נזיר brings on completing the vow in purity

steps.confusionAlert: They do not each bring both offerings. Together they bring one of each, and the stated condition decides which offering belongs to whom.

phrases.english: Two nazirites
to whom someone said:
"I saw one of you become impure,
but I do not know which one of you" —

phrases.aramaic: מְגַלְּחִין, וּמְבִיאִין קׇרְבַּן טוּמְאָה וְקׇרְבַּן טׇהֳרָה.
phrases.english: they shave, and bring an offering of impurity and an offering of purity.
And one says: If I am the impure one —
the offering of impurity is mine
and the offering of purity is yours;
and if I am the pure one —
the offering of purity is mine
and the offering of impurity is yours.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the new פרק after the הדרן.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: When it is uncertain which of two נזירים became impure, both shave and jointly bring one קרבן טומאה and one קרבן טהרה, each stating a condition so that each offering goes to whoever it truly fits.

steps.title: The two נזירים count thirty days and bring a conditional purity offering
steps.stepSummary: The משנה finishes its ruling. After the shared offerings, both נזירים count thirty days of נזירות and then together bring one more purity offering, with a condition that covers either possibility.
steps.simpleTranslation: They count thirty days and bring a purity offering. One of them says: 'If I was the impure one, the impurity offering we brought was mine, the purity offering was yours, and this one is my purity offering. If I was the pure one, the purity offering was mine, the impurity offering was yours, and this one is your purity offering.'
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues the case of the two נזירים from the last step and explains the second stage of their offerings.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first round of offerings already covered one impure נזיר and one pure נזיר, but nobody knows which was which. The impure one still needs a fresh thirty-day נזירות and a purity offering at the end, so both of them count thirty days. Then they bring one purity offering together, with a condition that it belongs to whichever of the two was really the impure one.

keyTerms.meaning: They count thirty days, a new term of נזירות
My purity offering
Your purity offering

steps.whatToRemember: The conditions make sure that whoever was really impure ends up with both an impurity offering and a final purity offering, and whoever was pure has his purity offering.

phrases.english: And they count thirty days,
and bring a purity offering,
and he says: If I am the impure one,
the impurity offering was mine
and the purity offering was yours,
and this one is my purity offering.
And if I am the pure one,
the purity offering was mine
and the impurity offering was yours,
and this one is your purity offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the משנה that began in step 4.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: After the shared offerings, they count thirty days and bring a purity offering with a condition, so that it goes to whichever one was impure.

steps.title: Why is this case treated as a doubtful impurity at all?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's case and asks why it is treated as a real doubt. The rule that a doubtful טומאה in a רשות היחיד counts as impure is learned from סוטה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה teaches about two נזירים where someone told them, 'I saw one of you become impure, and I don't know which one.' But why is this a doubt? Where do we learn the rule about a doubtful impurity in a private domain? From סוטה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins a challenge to the משנה. It names where the rule of ספק טומאה in a רשות היחיד comes from, which sets up the attack in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A doubtful טומאה is treated as impure only in a רשות היחיד. The גמרא points out that this rule comes from סוטה. That source will decide what counts as a 'private domain.'

keyTerms.meaning: A doubt whether something or someone became impure
A private domain; for טומאה, a place with few people
A woman suspected of adultery; the source for the rule about doubts
But why? A word that opens a challenge

phrases.english: GEMARA:
It teaches: two nazirites
to whom someone said: I saw one of you become impure,
and I do not know which of you.
But why?
Any doubtful impurity in a private domain,
from where do we learn it?
From סוטה.
phrases.notes: With a סוטה we are unsure whether she sinned, yet she is treated as forbidden. That is the model for treating a doubt as impure.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאַמַּאי? כֹּל סְפֵק טוּמְאָה בִּרְשׁוּת הַיָּחִיד מֵהֵיכָא יָלְפִינַן לֵהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא's discussion by questioning the משנה's case.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's assumption that the two נזירים have a doubtful טומאה that must be treated as impure.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The rule for doubts in a רשות היחיד comes from סוטה, so its limits must match סוטה. The next step spells out those limits.

steps.title: Three people make it a public domain, so the doubt should be pure
steps.stepSummary: Since סוטה involves only two people, a private domain means only two people are present. Here there are three: two נזירים and the witness. That makes it a רשות הרבים, where a doubt is treated as pure.
steps.simpleTranslation: A סוטה involves just two people, the man and the woman. So a doubtful impurity counts as 'private domain' only when there are two people. But here there are two נזירים plus the person standing with them, which makes three. So it is a doubt in a public domain, and every doubt in a public domain is pure!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes its challenge. It argues that the משנה's case should not be impure at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Comparing the case to סוטה sets the line at two people. The witness who saw it happen was standing there, so three people were present. That moves the case into the רשות הרבים rule, where a doubt is pure, so the נזירים should not need any offerings.

keyTerms.meaning: The man and the woman in the case of a סוטה, just two people
A public domain; for טומאה, a place with three or more people
Its doubt is treated as pure

steps.confusionAlert: Here 'private domain' and 'public domain' are not about walls or streets. They are about how many people are present: two counts as private, three counts as public.

phrases.english: Just as with a סוטה there is the adulterer and the adulteress,

phrases.aramaic: אַף כֹּל סְפֵק טוּמְאָה בִּרְשׁוּת הַיָּחִיד,
phrases.english: so too any doubtful impurity in a private domain
is a case where there are two people.
But here there are two nazirites
and this one who is standing with them,
phrases.notes: He means the witness who says he saw one of them become impure.

phrases.english: so that makes three.

phrases.aramaic: הָוֵה לֵיהּ סְפֵק טוּמְאָה בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים,
phrases.english: That makes it a doubtful impurity in a public domain,
and any doubtful impurity in a public domain,
its doubt is pure!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the challenge started in step 6 by applying the סוטה source to the case.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's ruling that the נזירים must bring offerings because of a doubtful טומאה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: סוטה means two people. Three people are present here, so this is a רשות הרבים, and there a doubt is pure.

steps.title: The witness saw an impure item thrown between them from a distance
steps.stepSummary: רבה בר רב הונא explains that the משנה is talking about a witness who says, 'I saw something impure thrown between you.' He was not standing with them, so only two people were really there.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבה בר רב הונא said: The case is where the person says, 'I saw something impure thrown in between you.'
steps.whatsHappening: רבה בר רב הונא answers the challenge by describing the משנה's case in a narrower way.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The witness was not part of the scene. He only watched from far away as something impure landed between the two נזירים. So only the two נזירים were present, which keeps it a רשות היחיד, and the doubt is treated as impure.

keyTerms.meaning: Was thrown between you
In a case where he says, which narrows down the case

phrases.english: Rabba bar Rav Huna said:
It is where he says: I saw an impure item
phrases.notes: The point is that he saw it from a distance and was not standing with them, so he does not count as a third person.

phrases.english: thrown between you.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא: בְּאוֹמֵר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of steps 6 and 7.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Narrows the case: the witness was not present at the scene.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The witness was standing with the נזירים, so there were three people, a רשות הרבים.
steps.terutzMaskana: The witness saw from a distance, so only two people were present. It is a רשות היחיד, and the doubt is impure.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that the count of people for this rule includes only those at the actual spot, not someone watching from far away.

steps.title: רב אשי begins to show the wording supports this
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי says the משנה's own wording supports רבה בר רב הונא's explanation. The proof itself comes on the next amud.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אשי said: The wording of the משנה is also precise and supports this.
steps.whatsHappening: This is a setup line. רב אשי announces that he will prove the answer from the משנה's exact words, and the proof comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: So far the answer was just an explanation. רב אשי now adds that something in the משנה's wording points to this same reading. The detail he relies on comes on the next amud.

keyTerms.meaning: It is also precise: the wording itself supports this point

phrases.english: Rav Ashi said: It is also precise,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supports the answer of step 8 from the משנה's wording.
steps.raayaObject: רבה בר רב הונא's explanation that the witness saw from a distance.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The precise wording of the משנה, which is spelled out on the next amud.
